JMC Sunday Recovery Ride

Jackson, MS · Road

JMC Sunday Recovery Ride is a road group ride in Jackson, MS. It rolls every Sunday at 2:00 pm from Varies; posted on the club's Facebook pages.

Next ride Sun, Oct 4, 2:00 PM CDT
Host's website ↗ Add to calendar Google Calendar Text it · WhatsApp · Email

Checked Oct 1, 2026. Confirmed against the sources at the foot of this page. Check the host's page before you go

How we know

Jackson Metro Cyclists' Local Rides page says 'The Sunday ride is a designated recovery ride that is typically 28 miles. The ride usually begins at 2:00pm'; the page is undated, but the club's calendar shows Oct 2026 events (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

When
Every Sunday, 2:00 pmSundays, usually 2:00 pm. A recovery-pace ride of about 28 miles; the start and route change week to week.

Varies; posted on the club's Facebook pages Map ↗

For visitors

The start is not fixed. Look for the week's post on the JMC and Madison/Ridgeland Cycling Facebook pages before you go.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 2:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: recovery pace.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the JMC Sunday Recovery Ride group ride

Jackson Metro Cyclists' designated recovery ride, typically 28 miles at an easy pace. It usually begins at 2:00 pm and the route changes each week.
